summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Elyan Aarts] (PhD Candidate, University of Amsterdam) – [September 23, 2024, 1:00 PM]:**
  - Requested pricing information for Avicenna app for an experience sampling study.
  - Mentioned pilot study with 20 participants and full study with 200 participants.
  - *Key quote:* "Would it be possible to provide me with an indication of the pricing?"

- **[Hanna Badalpoor] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [September 23, 2024, 1:00 PM]:**
  - Responded to pricing inquiry, explaining factors affecting pricing.
  - Requested participation period for exact quote.
  - *Key quote:* "I would be able to provide you with an exact quote if you let me know of the participation period of your study."

- **[Elyan Aarts] (PhD Candidate, University of Amsterdam) – [September 23, 2024, 2:24 PM]:**
  - Provided study details: survey data only, 10-day participation, 250 participants max.
  - *Key quote:* "Only survey and experience sampling data Each participant will be enrolled for 10 days."

- **[Hanna Badalpoor] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [September 23, 2024, 2:24 PM]:**
  - Provided exact quote: CAD 1,497.90 for 250 participants for 10 days.
  - Offered pilot study free of charge.
  - *Key quote:* "The cost of collecting survey response data from 250 participants for 10 days is CAD 1,497.90 (~ 995€)."

- **[Maryam Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [October 9, 2024, 5:30 PM]:**
  - Followed up on pilot study status.
  - *Key quote:* "I wanted to follow up to see if you have proceeded with the pilot study that was scheduled for October."

- **[Elyan Aarts] (PhD Candidate, University of Amsterdam) – [October 22, 2024, 11:43 AM]:**
  - Confirmed ethical approval and readiness to start pilot study.
  - *Key quote:* "We would like to go ahead with the pilot study using Avicenna, hopefully starting next week."

- **[Maryam Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [October 22, 2024, 11:43 AM]:**
  - Requested study details for invoice and license issuance.
  - *Key quote:* "Regarding the next steps, if you share the following information with me, I'll go ahead and send you the invoice."

- **[Elyan Aarts] (PhD Candidate, University of Amsterdam) – [October 28, 2024, 12:12 PM]:**
  - Shared study ID, project dates, and description.
  - *Key quote:* "The ID of the study: 4085 The project will starts on the 8th of November until November 2025."

- **[Maryam Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [October 28, 2024, 12:12 PM]:**
  - Confirmed invoice issuance.
  - *Key quote:* "Regarding the invoice, I have asked the finance team to issue and send your invoice."

- **[Elyan Aarts] (PhD Candidate, University of Amsterdam) – [November 6, 2024, 12:38 PM]:**
  - Noted payment delay and requested continuation on trial license.
  - *Key quote:* "Can I continue with the trial until the finance department comes through?"

- **[Maryam Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [November 11, 2024, 4:23 PM]:**
  - Temporarily adjusted license due to payment delay.
  - *Key quote:* "To assist you in continuing your study and data collection process while awaiting payment, we have temporarily adjusted your license."

#### **2. Timeline**
- **[September 23, 2024]:** Initial pricing inquiry and response.
- **[October 9, 2024]:** Follow-up on pilot study.
- **[October 22, 2024]:** Confirmation of pilot study readiness.
- **[October 28, 2024]:** Invoice issuance confirmed.
- **[November 6, 2024]:** Payment delay noted, trial license requested.
- **[November 11, 2024]:** Temporary license adjustment.

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**
- **Pricing Inquiry:** Resolved with detailed quote and free pilot offer.
- **Payment Delay:** Temporary license adjustment to continue study.

#### **4. Action Items**
- **Pending:**
  - Payment processing (assigned to University of Amsterdam finance department).
- **Completed:**
  - Pilot study setup.
  - Invoice issuance.

#### **5. Technical Details**
- **Study ID:** 4085
- **Project Description:** Influence of state self-regulation on anti-social behaviour.

#### **6. Next Steps**
- **Action 1:** Finalize payment (Elyan Aarts).
- **Action 2:** Monitor study progress (Maryam Hashemian).
